lines: Perumal Ramamurthy Srinivasan may sell up to ₹0.91 crore of shares in the offer, if all offered shares are sold.
Timing: the money is in hand since 11 Mar 2026 (8 months ago), and the trigger was shares unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, 66 days ago.
Gain is up to ₹0.67 crore before offer expenses and taxes; retained holding is an estimate of ₹2.13 crore at offer price.
Confidence is medium: name verified in the seller table, but holdings found in one section only.
